item.title: Historically Speaking: Louisa Maples
item.description: By Jessica Gorman Louisa Maples was born 28 December 1846. She was the fourth child of William C. Maples and Mary Margaret Evans and their first child born in Louisiana. The Maples family had come to the area just two years earlier from Tennessee. That trip was documented by a cousin of Mary Margaret Evans. … Continue reading Historically Speaking: Louisa Maples

item.title: Springhill fire injures one; cause of fire undetermined
item.description: Two camper trailers reportedly burned on Frederick Street in Springhill Tuesday night. Springhill resident Jerry Strahan filmed the fire from his house approximately one mile away. Strahan said to his knowledge there were no human fatalities, but emergency medical services were called for a person with possible third degree burns. His dog did not survive. … Continue reading Springhill fire injures one; cause of fire undetermined
